blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Scribble-supervised segmentation is typically evaluated with a fixed annotation set, leaving robustness to distinct semantic and geometric imperfections poorly understood. Motivated by an audit of 12,031 manual PASCAL Visual Object Classes (VOC) 2012 scribbles and prior work, we introduce six controlled perturbation operators. Class corruption, spatial offset, and directional perturbation directly operationalize audit signals. Stroke-length reduction is motivated by prior scribble studies, while random dropout and fragmentation serve as diagnostic controls. Each operator reports requested and achieved changes. We evaluate manual and automatic scribbles across two image domains, two principal backbone settings, and multiple training pipelines, with an additional MiT-B1 PFA anchor evaluation. In the five-seed Tree Energy Loss (TEL)-ResNet101 VOC study, mean intersection over union (mIoU) drops from 70.08 to 1.46 under class corruption, compared with 35.57 for spatial offset, 52.20 for directional perturbation, and 63.24 for stroke-length reduction at their strongest settings. At the evaluated endpoints, semantic-anchor corruption produces the largest degradation, while geometric and support responses depend on the pipeline and dataset. Our benchmark provides a reproducible protocol for diagnosing annotation robustness beyond clean-set accuracy. The operator code is available at https://github.com/Wmhiram99/scribble-operator-benchmark.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en:
For weakly supervised segmentation, a scribble labels only a few pixels, yet those pixels may supervise an
entire object. This makes scribbles an attractive alternative to costly
dense masks ( Papandreou et al., 2015 ; Dai et al., 2015 ; Bearman et al., 2016 ; Lin et al., 2016 ) . Modern pipelines propagate sparse labels through regularization ( Tang et al., 2018b ) , affinities ( Liang et al., 2022 ) , pseudo-labels ( Pan et al., 2021 ) , feature distributions ( Wu et al., 2023 ) , or prototypes ( Chan et al., 2024 ) . These mechanisms extend sparse anchors beyond labeled pixels and can
propagate the effect of an imperfect anchor.

blocks.en:
We summarize scribble imperfections along three complementary properties: semantic identity, spatial geometry, and support/connectivity. An incorrect class changes what an anchor denotes; displacement changes where supervision enters; direction alters local geometry; and shortening,
dropout, or fragmentation modify support and connectivity. We instantiate these properties through controlled perturbation operators, which transform clean scribbles into matched noisy training labels and together define the proposed robustness benchmark.
Existing work largely optimizes a fixed scribble set or studies selected variations in class-aware cues ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , generation ( Schnell et al., 2024 ) , and drawing style ( Boettcher et al., 2024 ; Zhang et al., 2025b ) . General noisy-label pipelines focus mainly on class corruption, while segmentation robustness benchmarks typically perturb the input image rather than the training annotation ( Patrini et al., 2017 ; Liu et al., 2022 ; Kamann and Rother, 2020 ) . Perturbing the training scribbles is necessary here because they define the sparse supervisory anchors whose semantic, geometric, and support errors are propagated during learning.
A unified, audit-grounded benchmark for decomposing scribble imperfections is therefore still missing. To ground such a benchmark empirically, we first audit discrepancies between manual scribbles and dense references, then translate the observed modes into controlled perturbations with measurable achieved values.

blocks.en: Our research questions are: RQ1: How can observed discrepancies between scribble annotations and dense references be translated into an audit-grounded benchmark of controlled scribble perturbations? RQ2: Which semantic, geometric, and support properties of scribble annotation most strongly affect segmentation? RQ3: Which response patterns persist across scribble annotation sources, datasets, backbones, and learning pipelines?

blocks.en: To investigate these research questions, we introduce an audit-to-stress-test benchmark , whose overall workflow is illustrated in Figure 1 . We audit 12,031 12{,}031 manual PASCAL VOC2012 scribbles ( Everingham et al., 2010 ) . The audit directly motivates class corruption, spatial offset, and directional perturbation. Stroke-length reduction is informed by prior scribble research, while random dropout and fragmentation are included as diagnostic controls. These six operations are implemented as controlled perturbation operators. The first four form the cross-setting benchmark because they have direct audit evidence or provide relatively isolated control of annotation properties.

blocks.en:
For each operator, ratios from 1.0 1.0 (the clean identity setting) to 0.1 0.1 request progressively stronger perturbations to the scribble labels. The achieved change can differ from the request because label maps are discrete and each operator has its own score definition. These labels are used to train the evaluated segmentation pipelines, whose predictions on validation RGB images are measured against dense ground truth. We analyze the resulting mIoU responses as operator-specific robustness profiles, extend the evaluation across datasets, backbones, and learning pipelines, and repeat selected settings with multiple seeds to assess the stability of the primary findings.
Our contributions can be summarized as: 1. A dataset-scale audit of 12,031 12{,}031 PASCAL VOC2012 scribbles that directly motivates three perturbation operators and informs a broader six-operation benchmark with achieved-value diagnostics. 2. A controlled analysis of how semantic, geometric, and support properties affect segmentation robustness under operator-specific perturbations. 3. Repeated-seed and cross-setting checks showing which response patterns are retained across annotation sources, datasets, backbones, and learning pipelines.

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en:
ScribbleSup established scribbles as an efficient weak annotation by alternating graphical label propagation with network learning ( Lin et al., 2016 ) .
Subsequent methods propagate sparse evidence through random-walk propagation ( Vernaza and Chandraker, 2017 ) , graph- and energy-based regularization ( Tang et al., 2018b ; Tang et al., 2018a ) , boundary guidance and progressive inference ( Wang et al., 2019 ; Xu et al., 2021 ) , and uncertainty-aware self-training ( Pan et al., 2021 ) .
Recent methods further use Transformer representations and class-conditional modeling ( Su et al., 2023 ; Wu et al., 2023 ) , tree-structured affinities ( Liang et al., 2022 ) , or prototype-based feature augmentation ( Chan et al., 2024 ) .
Despite their different mechanisms, these methods share a structural dependency. Labeled scribble pixels act as semantic and spatial anchors from which supervision is propagated.
Existing scribble-supervised methods mainly improve learning under a given annotation set through propagation, regularization, or representation design ( Lin et al., 2016 ; Pan et al., 2021 ; Liang et al., 2022 ; Chan et al., 2024 ) . Rather than improving learning for a fixed scribble set, we introduce an audit-informed benchmark that measures how controlled perturbations of the sparse label change segmentation performance, yielding operator-specific robustness profiles.

blocks.en:
Manual ScribbleSup Lin et al. (2016) annotations preserve annotator-dependent variation in placement, length, and shape, but are largely confined to PASCAL VOC.
Scribbles for All Boettcher et al. (2024) generates reproducible scribbles from dense masks across multiple 2D datasets, whereas ScribbleKITTI Unal et al. (2022) extends sparse supervision to 3D LiDAR scenes.
Other studies examine class-aware cues ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) , automatic scribble generation and augmentation ( Schnell et al., 2024 ) , and variation in drawing style ( Zhang et al., 2025b ) .
Interactive segmentation also studies tolerance to erroneous scribbles or clicks, but under online correction rather than offline scribble-supervised training ( Bai and Wu, 2014 ; Zhang et al., 2025a ) .
These efforts broaden annotation sources and styles but lack an audit-grounded protocol for separately measuring semantic, spatial, directional, support, and connectivity sensitivity within a common scribble source. Our audit-informed benchmark separates semantic, geometric, support, and connectivity sensitivity rather than treating scribble quality as a single variable.

blocks.en:
Noisy-label learning largely targets incorrect class assignments through noise-transition modeling and loss correction ( Sukhbaatar et al., 2015 ; Patrini et al., 2017 ) , robust learning objectives ( Zhang and Sabuncu, 2018 ) , and sample-selection or collaborative-training strategies ( Han et al., 2018 ; Arazo et al., 2019 ; Northcutt et al., 2021 ) .
A broader overview of these directions is provided by Song et al. ( Song et al., 2023 ) .
Segmentation additionally introduces spatially structured errors affecting pixels, regions, and boundaries ( Liu et al., 2022 ; Rottmann and Reese, 2023 ; Li et al., 2023 ) .
Scribble noise is distinct because sparse labels are subsequently propagated. The same number of altered pixels can have different effects depending on what they label, where they lie, and how much coherent support remains. Corruption benchmarks systematically vary image perturbations while holding annotations fixed ( Kamann and Rother, 2020 ) . We transpose this principle to the training annotation. Our benchmark audits 12,031 12,031 manual VOC scribbles and uses the supported disagreement patterns to motivate class, offset, and direction operators. Stroke-length reduction is informed by prior work, while dropout and fragmentation serve as diagnostic controls. All operations record requested and achieved properties. This design enables reproducible robustness analysis across annotation sources, datasets, backbones, and learning pipelines.

blocks.zh: 3 基准方法

blocks.en: 3.1 Problem setup
blocks.zh: 3.1 问题设置

blocks.en:
Let I i I_{i} denote an image, S i S_{i} its sparse scribble annotation, and Y i Y_{i} the corresponding dense reference. Here, clean refers to the original, unperturbed scribble map and does not imply perfect agreement with the dense reference.
We measure how a segmentation pipeline responds when one property of S i S_{i} is altered while the image is fixed.
Dense references are only used to audit the original annotations and to construct and measure controlled scribbles. They are never used as training targets. Although noisy scribble maps are also generated for validation images, validation does not consume them. The model predicts from validation RGB images, and fixed dense ground-truth (GT) masks are used to compute validation loss, mIoU, and checkpoint selection.

blocks.en:
We start from the manual PASCAL VOC scribbles because they retain variation introduced during annotation.
The audit covers 12,031 12{,}031 images: 10,582 10{,}582 from the augmented training set and 1,449 1{,}449 from the VOC validation set.
The scribbles and the VOC/Semantic Boundaries Dataset (SBD) references share the same image coordinates and label taxonomy ( Everingham et al., 2010 ; Hariharan et al., 2011 ) .
Automated screening compares them at pixel and connected-component levels.
The signals capture class disagreement, foreground–background leakage, spatial disagreement, a scribble class that is absent from the dense reference, and axial direction discrepancy.
The signals overlap, so the counts reported in Table 1 are not additive.

blocks.en:
The audit motivates semantic identity, spatial alignment, and trajectory direction. Prior work motivates coherent support ( Boettcher et al., 2024 ) . These four properties define the primary cross-setting benchmark.
Dropout and Fragmentation remain diagnostic controls because they couple support and connectivity rather than isolating one property. We distinguish isolated control, which preserves other measured properties where the discrete label map permits, from coupled control, whose construction necessarily changes an additional property. Class is isolated and Shrink approximately isolated. Offset, Direction, Dropout, and Fragmentation are coupled through translation, rotation, distributed removal, or cutting. Table 2 summarizes the six operators.

blocks.en: The lower Class attainment in the two Pascal settings is consistent with the discrete structure of this intervention. Class recolors an entire scribble component, so the achieved score changes in component-sized steps rather than continuously. We counted 8-connected components separately within each non-background semantic label in the raster annotations. The mean count per image was 2.35 (median 2) for manual VOC and 4.09 (median 3) for S4Pascal, so many images have only a few independently relabelable units. These counts provide a reproducible raster proxy for scribble units and do not imply that every component is exactly one pen stroke. With few units, attainable scores are coarse and a requested ratio can fall between attainable values. This offers a plausible explanation for missed Class targets when the smallest possible change already recolors one whole component. It is consistent with, but does not prove, the mechanism behind the dataset difference.

blocks.en: Taken together, the results show that the operators are not perfectly independent, but the measured off-target score changes are generally limited for Class and Direction and modest for most Offset and Shrink comparisons. We use a descriptive band from 0.95 to 1.05 around one as a practical near-no-change range for score ratios. Across the 27 dataset-by-ratio aggregate cells, all Class-output Offset and Direction ratios and all Direction-output Class ratios fall within this band. For Offset outputs, 27 of 27 Direction ratios and 20 of 27 Class-retention ratios fall within it. For Shrink outputs, 27 of 27 Class-retention ratios and 26 of 27 Direction ratios fall within it. This supports a positive but qualified interpretation that most measured off-target score effects are small under this descriptive criterion. It does not imply that support is unchanged. Offset can alter support location, whereas Shrink targets support extent. The reported overlap measure does not by itself distinguish relocation from total-area reduction. Some score ratios also depart from the band. The band is not a statistical equivalence test, and these operator-specific ratios are not probabilities. Class relabeling leaves the measured geometry and support unchanged. At the strongest setting, Direction outputs retain Class at 0.994–0.996 and have Offset ratios of 0.908–0.977. Offset outputs have Direction ratios of 0.964–1.001 and Class retention of 0.853–0.960. Shrink shows the clearest dataset-dependent geometric side effects while carrying out its intended support reduction. Figure 4 is the core evidence because it compares non-target properties with their no-change reference across strength levels. Table 4 complements the figure with changed-pixel and support measures at the strongest setting. The binding and score-kernel choices, component matching, and dataset-specific annotation structure limit exact cross-dataset comparison. These measurements quantify co-occurring label changes and should not be read as proof that a particular side effect independently causes a change in model performance.
blocks.zh: 总而言之,结果表明,操作员并非完全独立,但衡量到的离目标分数变化一般对类和方向有限,对大多数偏差和收缩比较来说是适度的。 我们使用0.95到1.05左右的描述带作为实际的分数比率近乎不变的幅度。 在整个27个数据集按比例汇总的单元格中,所有类产出偏移和方向比率以及所有方向产出类别比率都属于这一范围。 对于抵消的产出,27个方向比率中的27个和27个类别保留比率中的20个属于这一范围。 就收缩产出而言,27个留级比率中的27个和27个方向比率中的26个属于这一范围。 这支持一种积极但有保留的解释,即在这一描述性标准下,大多数衡量出的离目标分数效应很小。 这并不意味着支持保持不变。 偏移可以改变支持位置,而收缩目标则可以改变支持范围. 所报告的重叠措施本身并不区分迁移和总面积减少。 一些得分比率也与波段不同。 频段不是统计等同性测试,这些操作员特有的比率并不是概率. 分类再贴标签使测量到的几何和支撑保持不变. 在最强的情况下,方向产出保持0.994-0.996的分类,并有0.908-0.977的相抵比率。 减值产出的方向比率为0.964-1.001,类别保留为0.853-0.960。 收缩显示最清晰的依赖数据集的几何副作用,同时进行其预期的支持还原. 图4是核心证据,因为它比较了非目标属性和它们在整个强度水平上的无变化参考. 表4用变化像素和最强环境的支助措施来补充该数字。 绑定和得分内核选择,组件匹配,以及数据集特有注释结构限制了精确的跨数据集比较. 这些测量对共同发生的标签变化进行量化,不应被理解为某一副作用独立导致模型性能变化的证据.

blocks.en: 4.2 Evaluation Pipelines
blocks.zh: 4.2 评价管道

blocks.en: TEL (Tree Energy Loss) treats labeled scribble pixels as sparse anchors and constructs a tree-energy regularizer through affinity filtering and tree-structured propagation ( Liang et al., 2022 ) . It is therefore a useful primary pipeline for testing whether a controlled alteration to class identity, position, trajectory, or support changes the supervision propagated beyond the stroke.
blocks.zh: TTEL(Tree Energy Loss)将被标注的平像素视为稀疏锚地,并通过亲缘性过滤和树结构传播来构建出一种树能调节器(Liang等,2022年). 因此,它是一个有用的主要管道,用于测试控制下改变阶级身份、位置、轨迹或支持是否改变超出中风范围的监督。

blocks.en: Adapted DTS (Dynamic Teacher Switching) is a distinct teacher–student pipeline: two exponential moving average (EMA) teachers are assessed by their scribble loss, the selected teacher supplies confidence-filtered pseudo-labels, and hierarchical feature consistency regularizes the student ( Nguyen et al., 2026 ) . Only the selected teacher is EMA-updated in an iteration. We use DTS as an independent pipeline-sensitivity test, not as a strict line-by-line reimplementation or a matched-protocol leaderboard comparison. Its adapted architecture, losses, update order, and inference path are diagrammed in the supplementary material.
blocks.zh: 适应DTS(Dynamic Teacher Switching)是一个独特的师生管道:两个指数化的移动平均(EMA)教师根据其被打乱的丢失来评估,选定的教师提供可信赖的过滤伪标签,等级特征一致性使学生规范化(Nguyen等,2026年). 只有被选中的教师在迭代中更新了EMA. 我们使用DTS作为独立的管线灵敏度测试,而不是作为严格的逐行重施或相匹配的标头板比较. 其被改造的建筑,损耗,更新顺序,推论路径在补充材料中被绘制出图.

blocks.en: PFA (Prototype-Based Feature Augmentation) provides a third independent pipeline: class prototypes derived from labeled pixels augment the feature supervision available beyond the sparse marks ( Chan et al., 2024 ) . We include its VOC2012–MiT-B1 results as a compact external check on whether the observed operation response persists under a prototype-based learning mechanism.
blocks.zh: PFA(Prototype-based feature Advancement)提供第三条独立的管线:由被标记的像素所衍生的类原型能增强除稀有标记以外的可用特性监督(Chan等,2024). 我们把它的VOC2012-MIT-B1结果列为一个紧凑的外部检查,检查观察到的操作反应是否在原型学习机制下持续.

blocks.en:
Class corruption causes the largest degradation, reaching a five-seed mean of 1.46 1.46 mIoU in its strongest setting, compared with a clean-reference mIoU of 70.08 70.08 .
Its curve is strongly non-monotonic: performance first drops sharply, temporarily rebounds at an intermediate corruption level, and then decreases again under stronger corruption. The rebound is an observed response shape, not evidence of genuine recovery from incorrect semantic supervision.
blocks.zh:
阶级腐败造成最大规模的退化,在最强的环境下,五种种子平均含量为1.461.46毫升;而清洁参考度为70.08 70.08毫升。
它的曲线强烈地非莫名:表现先是急剧下降,在中间的腐败水平上暂时反弹,再在更强烈的腐败下再次下降. 反弹是一种被观察到的反应形状,而不是从不正确的语义监督中真正恢复的证据.

blocks.en: One possible explanation is that highly unreliable scribbles cause the model to rely relatively more on image features and TEL’s structural constraints. The validation trajectories provide indirect support because the loss becomes less stable under stronger corruption, but they do not establish this mechanism or explain the rebound conclusively.
blocks.zh: 一个可能的解释是,高度不可靠的拼写使得模型相对更多地依赖于图像特征和TEL的结构限制. 验证轨迹提供了间接支持,因为损失在更强烈的腐败下变得不那么稳定,但它们并没有建立这种机制或对反弹作出决定性的解释.

blocks.en:
The spatial offset is the strongest geometric perturbation, reaching a five-seed mean of 35.57 35.57 mIoU at its strongest setting. Its degradation is consistent with attaching class evidence to unsuitable locations.
The resulting geometric side effects are retained in the reported response because they form part of the complete spatial intervention.

空间相抵是最强的几何扰动,在最强的环境下达到35.57 35.57 mIoU的五种种子平均值. 其降解与不适当地点的分类证据相符。
由此产生的几何副作用被保留在所报道的响应中,因为它们构成了完整的空间干预的一部分.

blocks.en:
Directional perturbation produces a weaker response than class corruption and spatial offset, with a five-seed mean of 52.20 52.20 mIoU at its strongest setting.
This result indicates that trajectory changes are harmful, while remaining class and spatial information can still provide useful supervision.

定向扰动产生的反应比类腐败和空间相抵消更弱,在最强的环境下五种子平均52.20 52.20 mIoU.
这一结果表明,轨迹变化是有害的,而其余的类别和空间信息仍然可以提供有益的监督。

blocks.en: Stroke-length reduction is comparatively mild, with a five-seed mean of 63.24 63.24 mIoU at its strongest setting. Correctly labeled support reduction is less damaging than changing the semantic identity or spatial anchoring of the scribble when some meaningful support remains.

blocks.en: Comparing VOC2012 with S4Pascal isolates annotation-source effects. They share the same PASCAL images and dense ground-truth masks, but use manual and GT-derived scribbles, respectively. Comparing S4Pascal with S4Cityscapes probes broader dataset and scene-structure effects. Both use the automatic Scribble4All pipeline, while differing in domain, resolution, scene layout, class set, and scribble density.
blocks.zh: 将VOC2012与S4Pascal进行比对,将注释-源效应隔离. 他们共享相同的PASCAL图像和密集的地真口罩,但分别使用人工和GT出自的拼写. 将S4Pascal和S4Cityscapes进行比较,可以探测到更广泛的数据集和场景结构效应. 两者都使用自动Scrible4All管道,同时在域,解析度,场景布局,类集,和斯克利布密度上有所不同.

blocks.en: Class corruption is similarly damaging on VOC2012 and S4Pascal. S4Pascal is generally less sensitive to spatial offset and directional perturbation, which may reflect the greater spatial regularity of its GT-derived scribbles. Stroke-length reduction shows a small reversal between the two datasets. A rough length proxy, computed as the published labeled-area fraction divided by the published mean scribble count and an assumed width of approximately 4 4 pixels ( Boettcher et al., 2024 ) , is about 21 % 21\% higher for VOC2012 than for S4Pascal. This ratio of aggregate statistics is not the mean of per-image stroke lengths and should be interpreted only as a descriptive estimate. It may partly explain the greater tolerance to stroke-length reduction.
blocks.zh: 阶级腐败对VOC2012和S4Pascal也有类似的破坏. S4Pascal对空间相抵消和方向扰动的敏感度一般较低,这可能反映其GT出自的字母的空间规律性较大. 弦长还原显示两个数据集之间的小倒转. 一个粗长的代用符,以公布的正弦分数除以已公布的被标记区域分数和假定宽度约为4个像素(Boettcher等人,2024年)计算,VOC2012比S4Pascal大约高21% 21%. 这种总的统计比率不是每个图像中风长度的平均值,应仅被解释为描述性估计. 这可能部分地解释了对中风长减的更能耐性。

blocks.en: S4Cityscapes is more tolerant of directional perturbation but more sensitive to spatial offset and stroke-length reduction. This response is compatible with its urban layouts, thin structures, adjacent objects, and different scribble density. No dataset is uniformly more robust: the response depends jointly on scribble source, scene structure, density, and perturbation type.
blocks.zh: S4Cityscapes更能容忍方向性扰动,但对空间相抵和中风长还原更为敏感. 这种响应与其城市布局相容,结构细小,相邻的物体,以及不同的斯克布克密度相通. 没有数据集是统一地更坚固的:反应会共同依赖于斯克布克源,场景结构,密度和扰动类型.

blocks.en: Class corruption remains the strongest perturbation for both backbones, and changing the backbone does not remove the semantic-anchor risk. SegFormer-B4 is generally more tolerant of stroke-length reduction on the automatically generated datasets, possibly reflecting its ability to exploit remaining sparse support through multi-scale token representations. ResNet101 is generally more robust to spatial offset and directional perturbation on VOC2012 and S4Pascal, whereas SegFormer-B4 has a small advantage on S4Cityscapes. Backbone robustness is therefore conditional on both the perturbation and the dataset.

blocks.en: To examine robustness across learning mechanisms, we compare three scribble-supervision pipelines: affinity-guided TEL, teacher–student DTS, and prototype-augmented PFA. This comparison helps distinguish recurring responses from pipeline-specific ones.

blocks.en: 6 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 6 结论

blocks.en: We present an audit-informed benchmark of six scribble perturbations. Semantic corruption causes the largest loss, followed by spatial offset. Direction and Shrink have milder, setting-dependent effects. Robustness depends on sparse-label content and placement.
blocks.zh: 我们提出一个有审计依据的基准,其中包含6起骚乱。 语义腐败造成的损失最大,其次是空间抵消。 方向和收缩效果较为温和,依赖设定. 强健性取决于缺少标签的内容和位置.

blocks.en: Our GT-guided operators enable controlled diagnosis of specific annotation properties. Connecting them to the frequency and causes of human errors is an important next step. The complete multi-seed TEL–VOC study and targeted extensions provide a basis for broader validation. Future work will combine human-annotation studies with these diagnostics to develop adaptive, corruption-aware training across datasets, architectures, and annotation sources.
blocks.zh: 我们的GT制导操作员能够对特定注解特性进行有控制的诊断. 将它们与人类出错的频率和原因联系起来是下一个重要步骤。 完整的多种子TEL-VOC研究和有针对性的扩展为更广泛的验证提供了基础. 今后的工作是将人与人之间的说明研究与这些诊断结合起来,以便在数据集、结构和说明来源之间开展适应性、有腐败意识的培训。
